Maya: Quick thread to lock down owners for shard-drain + fragmentation follow-ups after the KV OOM. Need playbook items, short timelines, and what goes into the canary.

Aj: I'll do targeted heap snapshots and a short flamegraph run on staging. Repro with replay, 15-30m traces.

Sara: I'll implement an emergency drain hook and soft-limit config. Plan: `kv.soft_limit_pct=68`, `kv.eviction_window=5m` for testing.

Leo: I'll own canary gates and alerting. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% with blocks if eviction_rate > 5/s or avg_gc_pause >200ms.

Priya: I'll add a recurring report that flags shards with sustained >10% growth over 6h and tag for ops review.

Aj: Staging commands:
```
./infra/reserve --pool=staging-kv --hours=2 --start=1766670000
./tools/replay --from=2026-03-18T02:00Z --dur=1h --isolate
./bin/kv-profiler --out=/tmp/kv.prof --time=20m
```

OpsBot: reserved staging-kv 1766670000-1766677200. Owner: infra. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Owners & due dates: Aj +2bd, Sara +3bd, Leo +4bd, Priya +6bd. Weekly Friday 10am PT check-ins until resolved. Post one-line status by EOD tomorrow.

Aj: status: profiler flags ready, will run once pool is up.

Sara: status: draft PR with drain hook and soft-limit config coming up.

Leo: status: dashboard panels templated; need metric names from Aj.

Priya: status: report job configured, starting backfill for 45d.

Maya: Notes: keep profiling isolated; frag_ratio noisy so use 5m median smoothing; if frag_ratio >0.5 after tuning, consider offline compaction run.

Aj: filing an upload location: gs://redwood-dev/kv-profiles/1766666000/

Sara: adding compaction playbook to PR description.

Maya: Thanks all. Ping this thread for blockers.

Leo: end.
